jobs.title: AI Research Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Amperos

Amperos is healthcare's first AI-native denial management and revenue recovery platform. Our agentic AI works claims end-to-end, from portal follow-ups and payor calls to appeals and medical records, so providers can resolve more denials, recover more revenue, and focus on what matters most: serving patients.

We just closed a $16M Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with continued participation from Uncork Capital and Neo. We're still small, still early, and going after a $260B+ problem that's only getting worse. If you want to work on hard problems that matter, alongside people who care deeply about the mission (and each other), we'd love to meet you.

About the role

As an AI Engineer on our research team, you’ll work on our hardest research and AI infra problems. You’ll both help prototype new products and also work on turning prototypes into a high quality AI product. Hard problems include passing the healthcare billing Turing Test - would an insurance agent who is interacting with our AI or a healthcare biller who is reviewing the work of our AI think our AI is a human, and not an AI? More concretely, you will be working to improve our AI agent’s quality so it acts more human-like and collects more accurate and detailed results from insurance.

What you’ll do

  • Main focus is on improving models, LLM orchestration, prompt optimizations, evaluation framework, and AI infra

  • Enable agent/workflow product engineers

  • Own and raise the bar on AI quality

  • Own ultimate vision of end to end AI orchestration of modules

  • Work on hardest research problems (ie. Anti-AI)

  • Mainly a mix of ML, data science, and applied LLM work. Heavy Python.

Who we’re looking for

  • You like reading the latest LLM research papers

  • Deep experience in implementing and building AI agents

  • Eager to try out the latest releases (ie. o1, OpenAI voice mode, Claude Computer-Use) to see how it can be used in real-world healthcare billing applications

  • Worked with complex distributed systems with many async operations

  • Excited about pushing the boundaries of conversational AI technology

  • Can balance quick experimentation with systematic evaluation

  • Very high Python mastery

Perks & Benefits

  • In-person culture at our Flatiron office in NYC with paid lunch and dinner

  • Flexible hours and time off

  • Gym stipend

  • Commuter benefits

  • Health, dental, vision insurance

  • 401(k) with matching contribution

  • Annual offsite

Our Values

  • Lead with Empathy - Great products and teams are built on empathy—whether for our customers, users, or team members. We take the time to walk in others' shoes, listen actively, and truly understand their challenges, needs, and perspectives.

  • Humbly Ambitious - We combine humility with ambition. No task is beneath us, and no challenge too big. Greatness comes from being willing to do whatever it takes, while having the courage to take bold risks and learn from failures.

  • Radical Agency - Own your domain. Drive initiatives with autonomy and accountability. Think deeply, communicate with the team, and maintain a bias for action.

Amperos Health is the leading provider of multi-modal RCM agents empowering healthcare clinics to collect more revenue, faster. Founded in 2023 and backed by Uncork, Neo, Nebular.vc and strategic angels from OpenAI, Stripe, and Twilio, we're on a mission to revamp the bridge between healthcare providers and payers. Our vision is to equip healthcare providers with an AI workforce that reduces administrative burden and accelerates revenue.

About the role

Our clients are on many different healthcare PM systems that are either remote desktops or browser based and often behind strict security requirements. We need to use a combination of APIs (usually not possible), RPA, and agentic methods to be able to enable the capabilities we offer.

To support our fast growth and new customers, we need to be able to build out new integrations for new systems efficiently as well as develop a framework for reliability and monitoring. You’ll get to join our new Integrations team and shape how this team grows.

What you’ll do

  • Build and maintain integrations with healthcare EMR software using APIs, RPA, or agentic flows

  • Work closely with clients to figure out how to access their PM system and how it works to be able to build a successful automation

  • Implement monitoring and observability infrastructure to make our integrations more reliable

  • Figure out how to scale building integrations for new PM systems with a repeatable framework

  • Prototype and productionize new capabilities that require integrating with PM systems (ie. fetching certain pieces of data from PM systems)

Who we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering specifically for healthcare integrations

  • Can work with customer directly to solve their problems rather than just following specs

  • Flexible hours and time off

The RCM QA Specialist owns the quality of work produced by both our billing associates and our AI agents. As our AI capabilities grow, this role becomes central to making sure both humans and machines hit the standard our clients expect.

What You'll Do

  • Audit claim work for action accuracy, claim-issue accuracy, and documentation quality, following our QA process

  • QA agent outputs across calls, payer portals, and denial workflows, comparing logged results to the source of truth and flagging error patterns and drift

  • Build and maintain QA scorecards, trackers, and dashboards in Excel or Sheets, and help shape reporting in our BI tools

  • Design automated or rule-based quality checks that catch recurring errors before they require manual review

  • Calibrate QA standards across reviewers, maintain QA rubrics, and support our critical-error-free rate target

  • Track appeal and overturn outcomes and other quality KPIs

  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills (pivot tables, lookups, conditional logic) and genuine comfort working with data

  • Detail-oriented and organized, able to document quality standards clearly

  • Comfortable evaluating AI-generated work and giving structured, actionable feedback

  • Able to work US hours (9am to 6pm ET)

    • Keep all employee and payroll data confidential, organized, and audit-ready

    • Working knowledge of Indian labour law and statutory compliance (EPF, ESI, tax withholding, Shops and Establishments Act)

    • Experience building HR processes or policies where none existed, not just administering mature ones

  • Skills and attributes

    • Comfortable being the person employees come to, and comfortable telling a manager something they don't want to hear

    • Clear written and verbal communication in English; able to handle sensitive conversations with discretion

    • Proficiency with HRIS and payroll platforms (Deel strongly preferred), Excel/Sheets, and documentation tools (Notion, Google Drive, Linear)
